$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: it is the run the harness refuses to score. The agent halted after Step 2
and wrote a context summary and a threshold matrix, so the deliverable exists and declares a section for
none of the four audited domains.
That is an environment failure rather than an audit that got every domain wrong, and the difference is the
one this repository's harnesses are most careful about: a lost run must never report as a low score.
derivation: parseReport finds no heading matching any of the four `<Domain> Assessment` forms, so it returns null and
reportFromArtifact reports environment-missing-artifact. Nothing is scored, so the stored result carries the
failure class and no numbers at all.
